review.tagline: Chat-driven React app builder that clones sites via Firecrawl and runs code in sandboxes
review.summary: Next.js app where you describe a React app in chat and an LLM generates and edits the code inside a remote sandbox (Vercel Sandbox by default, or E2B). It uses the Firecrawl API to scrape existing sites as reference material. The LLM can be Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI or Groq, with optional Morph for faster edit application.
review.audience: Developers who want a self-run prompt-to-React app builder to study or fork
strengths: Supports four LLM providers: Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI and Groq, chosen via env keys
Sandbox backend is switchable between Vercel Sandbox and E2B with one variable
Setup is clone, install, set .env.local, run pnpm dev on port 3000
weaknesses: Requires a Firecrawl API key; it is listed as required
Needs a Vercel or E2B account for sandboxes; no local sandbox option documented
Described as an example app; no docs on deployment, auth or persistence
No Dockerfile or compose file, and no tagged releases
needs: Needs Firecrawl API, Vercel Sandbox or E2B, Morph (optional)
